mentions.name: Webbu
mentions.description: A web app for learning languages through short stories, with progress tracking, audio pronunciation of words, and difficulty levels up to advanced.
mentions.audience: Web app for people learning languages.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm improving my web app to learn languages with short stories: https://webbu.app. I've been making it easier to track your progress, hear pronunciation of words, and adding more advanced levels.
